clips.title: The story
paras: Agitators is an early task on Zephras Isle issued by Yala Windwatcher. The aggressive Al'Aketh cult has pushed into Thendal Grove, agitating the peaceful native wind sprites into hostile elementals. Adventurers are sent to disperse the roiling winds and clear out the cultist converts threatening the area.

Thendal Grove has fallen under the shadow of the Al'Aketh cult. Known for their unsettling designs on Zephras Isle, the cultists have encroached on the grove and actively riled the delicate wind spirits dwelling there. Once peaceful sprites have turned violent, forming volatile roiling winds that threaten anyone passing through the region.

Yala Windwatcher tasks passing champions with subduing both the enraged elementals and the Al'Aketh converts fomenting the unrest. While putting down the wind creatures restores a fragile calm to the grove, dealing with the cultists is a somber duty: Yala laments the shedding of shen'dorei blood among their own people, yet recognizes that the cult leaves little choice.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent.
Regrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. We also need to send a clear message to the cult that they are not welcome in the grove.
Will you lend me your aid, adventurer?

clips.title: Completion
paras: It pains me to shed shen'dorei blood here in the grove, but we do what we must.
